content: Elevation: unpackaged WinUI3 apps use standard Win32 app.manifest requestedExecutionLevel=requireAdministrator, same as WinForms/WPF. The severe WinRT-activation-fails-when-elevated bug affects PACKAGED (MSIX) WinUI3 apps only, because per-user COM/WinRT registrations aren't visible to an elevated process. Unpackaged apps sidestep this since they don't rely on that registration path. A separate, now-fixed bug (WindowsAppSDK issue #3054, fixed internally, milestone 1.3) caused a manifest-merge build error 'c1010001 values of attribute level not equal' when combining WindowsAppSDKSelfContained=true with a custom requireAdministrator app.manifest; current SDK (2.3.1, well past 1.3) should build cleanly with the standard manifest snippet.
